log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL

bind_host.description: Host interface to bind RPC server to (usually not exposed externally)

bind_port.description: Port to bind RPC server to (typically unused in zone-manager)

workers.description: Number of worker processes for handling zone management tasks

rpc_workers.description: Number of RPC worker threads (often set equal to workers)

rpc_transport_url.description: Message broker URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or other supported transport)

zone_sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between zone synchronization runs

zone_sync_batch_size.description: Maximum number of zones processed in each synchronization batch

zone_processing_retries.description: Number of retry attempts when processing a zone fails

zone_retry_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) between retries for failed zone processing

service_endpoints.description: List of OpenStack service endpoints the zone manager interacts with (e.g., for notifications or sync)

region.description: OpenStack region name for the service

service_type.description: Service type in the OpenStack service catalog (e.g., 'dns')

project_name.description: Optional: project name for service auth

pool_enabled.description: Enable connection pooling for the database backend

pool_size.description: Maximum number of persistent DB connections in the pool

pool_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of additional DB connections beyond pool_size

pool_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for acquiring a DB connection
